about_the_game:
Exploration is bound to make you hungry. Peel back the flesh and the muscle and cut to the bone to find earthly delights from across time. The Spelunking for Your Life Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, the Weary Traveller cell customization pack, 3 cell items and a player icon.  

 The Spelunking For Your Life Pack includes the following: 

  • Craniac Suit 

  • Chromiac Suit 

  • Roast Beef cell item 

  • Weary Traveller cell customization pack  

  • Roast Beef cell item 

  • Wallpaper cell item 

  • Floor cell item 

  • A player icon
